author: Cat Spaventa
body: Baby sleep answers really helped our whole family get back to sleep. We have an almost one year old who slept wonderfully until she didn’t. Up at least once a night and waking at 5a daily. We knew we had fallen into some unhelpful habits but needed a practical, hands on, easy to understand approach of our options. We didn’t know how to help ourselves and we were too tired to read a million books and figure it out ourselves. I needed an option that got right to the point and right to an action plan. Baby sleep answers to the rescue. Our daughter is sleeping 12 hours a night now after implementing a new routine and sleep training. I liked that there were options based on your comfort level. Thanks for everything!!!
